$comment: Publishing pipeline configuration. Committed on purpose — it holds ids and names, never secrets. Tokens live in the gitignored .env.publish. Every id below is a placeholder: replace them with your own before running any publish script.

jira.$comment: Link types applied to every bug raised from a failing TC. Each parent is passed as inwardIssue and the bug as outwardIssue, so the bug appears under the parent's Bug section rather than the reverse.

default.label: <SPACE> / Test plans
default.$comment: evidencePattern decides which capture files are uploaded alongside the page, so the Evidence column embeds resolve. Env suffixes come from evidence-reporter.ts.
default.$comment2: Confluence folder parents reject parentId on update; page parents accept it. Set true only when parentId is a page.

zephyr.$comment: Folder names as they appear in Zephyr Scale. rootFolder must already exist in the project; the per-ticket folder is created underneath it.

teams.$comment: Envs that must ALL be green before a pass notification may be posted. Set to [] to allow any env.
